profile.name: Surjit Singh
profile.title: AI Platform Engineer & Senior Backend Engineer
profile.summary: AI/ML Platform and Python Backend Engineer with 5 years of experience specializing in high-performance distributed systems, Kubernetes infrastructure, and production LLM deployments. Proven track record of architecting scalable identity providers, event-driven microservices, and bare-metal GPU clusters that drastically reduce inference latency and cloud costs. Strong focus on zero-trust security, resilient messaging, and agentic AI architectures.

experience.role: AI Platform Engineer & Senior Backend Engineer
achievements: Enterprise AI Platform: Architected a FastAPI and LangChain platform serving 300+ employees with department-level RBAC for identity-gated AI agents; powered inference via bare-metal vLLM and ChromaDB, optimizing 15k-token context pipelines to slash P99 latency from 8.0s to 3.5s and reduce OpEx by 27%.

Enterprise Identity Platform (IdP): Built a custom Python IdP (OAuth2, PKCE, TOTP) for 600+ employees; engineered a stateless authentication mesh using asymmetric JWTs (public-key) with 15-minute TTLs, enabling zero-network-hop token verification alongside secure Redis-backed session revocation.

AMT Concrete & Scaler: Engineered a zero-touch Kubernetes appliance for the Azure Marketplace; automated bare-metal cluster bootstrapping, dynamic node enrollment via KEDA, and human-free Vault auto-unsealing, delivering enterprise deployments without managed K8s dependencies.

Notify: Developed an event-driven Python FastAPI notification service utilizing Kafka consumers, Protocol Buffers, and idempotent processing for guaranteed delivery of 120k+ daily emails and messages across multi-channel APIs.

Enterprise AI Integration: Engineered lightweight completion API hooks connected to UI/bot buttons within legacy apps, automating critical workflows (such as delivery price predictions) and empowering Customer Service and Delivery Hub teams to execute backend operations and query knowledge bases instantly.

Technical Leadership: Directed a team of 4 junior engineers, overseeing sprint execution, enforcing code quality standards, and mentoring the team on modern Python architecture and system design best practices.
Spearheaded the modernization of the core resume parsing engine, replacing legacy rules-based Regex and Bi-LSTM models with state-of-the-art Transformer architectures.
Orchestrated a 14-person cross-functional team to curate a proprietary, high-quality annotation dataset of 5,000+ complex edge cases for Named Entity Recognition (NER).
Trained and fine-tuned custom BERT models on the proprietary dataset, surging extraction accuracy for highly variable fields from 71% to a production-ready 94.6%.
Engineered the inference migration from CPU-bound pipelines to NVIDIA T4 GPUs, achieving a 40% reduction in serving latency while increasing model parameter count.
Deployed the optimized NLP models via REST APIs utilizing Flask, enabling high-throughput ingestion for downstream enterprise clients.
